# Subnetwork

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A network inside a node. Double-click to enter. Promote parameters to control the inside from here.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "subnet", "name": "subnet", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in0"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out0"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
